description: This file contains a Java class 'JuelConnector' that acts as a bridge between the OFBiz framework and the JUEL expression language library. It includes custom classes to enable auto-vivify behavior in expression evaluation, modifies parsing to handle specific expression patterns, and provides factory methods for creating customized ExpressionFactory instances.

classes.name: JuelConnector
classes.description: A facade class to connect OFBiz with the JUEL library, providing methods to create customized ExpressionFactory instances and internal classes for auto-vivify support in expression evaluation.

classes.name: JuelConnector.ExtendedAstBracket
classes.description: Extends AstBracket to implement auto-vivify logic when setting values in expressions.

classes.name: JuelConnector.ExtendedAstDot
classes.description: Extends AstDot to implement auto-vivify logic when setting values in expressions.

classes.name: JuelConnector.ExtendedParser
classes.description: Custom parser class that handles special expression syntax and creates extended AST nodes.

classes.name: JuelConnector.ExtendedBuilder
classes.description: Builder class that uses the ExtendedParser to build AST trees with auto-vivify capabilities.

methods.name: JuelConnector.newExpressionFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ExpressionFactory instance with extended capabilities.
